quotes.text: It's awfully noisy out there, soliciting AI solutions for everything you can think of, whether it's in the field, in your office, or just being an AI assistant to an executive.
I'm a big believer in breaking the system as much as you possibly can. Because if they can fix it, and if they can fix it fast enough, you get better adoption.

Our documentation fifteen years ago was a diary, a daily report that was handwritten that said this is what happened and we trusted that's what happened. Now, if it doesn't get documented, it never happened.
